issues.message: CHK-002 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

3 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Confirm and extract the two inputs: REVIEW round count and per-round blocking-finding counts + Implement core/review-convergence.ts pure function plus threshold constants and the advisory message builder are performed simultaneously?)
1 risk signal(s) have been dismissed by main agent (reasons in story.riskSignalsDismissed): State Machine/Gate

understanding still has 1 undigested unknowns: Exact placement of the per-round blocking-count accessor and assessReviewConvergence (new core/review-convergence.ts importing from advisory.ts, vs extending advisory.ts) — resolved in CHK-001/CHK-002; either is acceptable as long as existing helpers are reused, not duplicated.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation
